## Behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Scope and provenance

List relevant issues, upstream commits and third-party data/license changes.

## Validation

Record commands, device/build versions and observed results. Distinguish automated tests, manual checks and unverified targets. Include latency/memory evidence for performance claims.

## Limitations

Document remaining behavior, migration and public-distribution blockers.

- [ ] Editor text, credentials, private screenshots and recordings are absent from the diff.
- [ ] Password/private fields and editor changes are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Source comments, documentation, commits and PR descriptions are in English.
